name: Unfold
description: Deployable demo: one Node server for the API, the student web app (/) and the social-worker console (/worker/).

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:worker && npm run build:student
scripts.build:worker: npm ci --prefix unfold/worker-web --include=dev && npm run build --prefix unfold/worker-web
scripts.build:student: npm ci --prefix unfold --include=dev && cd unfold && EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=/ EXPO_PUBLIC_WORKER_URL=/worker/ npx expo export --platform web
